fact: The document is the text of Botswana's Statistics Act (Cap. 17:01, Act No. 15 of 2009), which establishes Statistics Botswana and the National Statistical System and states a commencement date of 1 December 2010.
Statistics Botswana's annual report says the body is established under the Statistics Act of 2009 and is guided by it in carrying out its mandate.

The annual report says the Statistics Botswana Board is constituted in conformity with section 6 of the Statistics Act, with nine members appointed by the Minister and the Statistician General ex-officio, in the year to 31 March 2024.
